name: Quiet Hours
protocol_description: No loud music, TV, or guests in shared spaces from 11pm to 7am on weeknights.

name: Dish Duty
protocol_description: Wash your own dishes within 24 hours. Shared pots and pans are washed by whoever used them last.

name: Guest Policy
protocol_description: Overnight guests are allowed up to 3 nights a week. Let roommates know in the group chat beforehand.

name: Trash and Recycling
protocol_description: Trash goes out every Monday and Thursday. Rotate weekly in this order: Demo, Jane, Nollie, Nicolai, Anjela.

name: Thermostat Settings
protocol_description: Keep the thermostat between 68 and 72 degrees. Ask before changing it outside that range.

name: Bathroom Cleaning
protocol_description: The bathroom is deep cleaned every Sunday. The schedule rotates weekly between all roommates.
